# Piano Chord Explorer

> A free English-language piano chord reference and browser-based practice website. The site includes 29 independently authored chord lessons, 120 searchable chord formulas, an 88-key virtual piano, original SVG diagrams, and local recording/export.

Canonical website: https://pianochordexplorer.com/
Content language: en
Contact: contact@pianochordexplorer.com

## Start here

- [Home](https://pianochordexplorer.com/): what the site offers; common chord formulas and learning paths.
- [Chord lessons](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/): links to 29 authored triad and seventh-chord lessons.
- [Reading piano chord diagrams](https://pianochordexplorer.com/guides/how-to-read-piano-chords/): notes, chord qualities and inversions.
- [Seventh chords explained](https://pianochordexplorer.com/guides/seventh-chords-piano/): dominant, major, minor and half-diminished sevenths.
- [Chord finder](https://pianochordexplorer.com/tools/chord-finder/): identify a supported chord from three or four pitch classes.
- [120-chord library](https://pianochordexplorer.com/tools/chord-library/): interactive major, minor, seventh, suspended and diminished formulas.
- [88-key piano](https://pianochordexplorer.com/tools/virtual-piano/): play, record and export on your device.
- [Printable piano chord chart](https://pianochordexplorer.com/printables/piano-chord-chart/): a printable sixteen-chord visual reference.

## Five practical starter lessons

- [B minor (Bm)](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/b-minor/)
- [B-flat major (Bb)](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/b-flat-major/)
- [D minor (Dm)](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/d-minor/)
- [E minor (Em)](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/e-minor/)
- [G major (G)](https://pianochordexplorer.com/chords/g-major/)

## Theory, limitations and transparency

- Chord formulas use twelve-tone equal temperament. Note spelling depends on harmonic context; enharmonic keys can have different theoretical names.
- Original illustrations show one reference voicing, not a prescribed fingering or an acoustic piano sample.
- Browser-based chord detection covers supported three- and four-note families; it does not infer every possible chord function.
